$comment: The hero classes a new game offers (D&D 5e SRD). character: the sprite set (src/characters/). hitDie: rolled per level in the tabletop game. hitPoints: what the hero has here (for now the same for everyone). abilities: the standard array (15, 14, 13, 12, 10, 8) placed as the class's quick build suggests. armor: light, medium, heavy, shield; weapons: simple, martial (wearing armour without proficiency gives disadvantage on attacks; a weapon without it loses the proficiency bonus). features: unarmored_defense (no armour: AC 10 + DEX + CON), fighting_style_defense (+1 AC in armour).
